en_how: Each cell is two half-flaps with a hinge seam; cells start flipping staggered by column and row and step through a run of characters at a fixed rate (digits for digit cells, a character pool for Chinese cells), the top half squashing toward the hinge and the bottom half unfolding, with both screen changes derived from t; a station header, a ticking clock and one blinking amber status light complete the board.
